DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Myelofibrosis

The bone marrow biopsy showing dysplastic megakaryocytes, combined with teardrop cells (dacrocytes) and leukoerythroblastosis, confirms bone marrow fibrosis. The normal chest X-ray helps rule out metastatic disease, making myelofibrosis the most likely diagnosis. I will proceed with genetic testing (JAK2, CALR, MPL) and measure serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) levels to confirm.
